figures.title: Magnetic and Electronic Properties of Monolayer Cr₄S₄FBr₂ Family and Several 2D Monolayer and Bilayer (BL) Materials

Spin-resolved band structures and total density of states (TDOS) of monolayer Cr₄S₄FBr₂ for the (a) positive (P ↑) and (b) negative (P ↓) ferroelectric polarization states. (c) Electrostatic potential on the isosurface ranging from −0.1 Ry (red) to 2.0 Ry (yellow) for monolayer Cr₄S₄FBr₂. (d) Energy evolution along the ferroelectric switching pathway between bistable states in monolayer Cr₄S₄FBr₂. The inserts display the initial, intermediate, and final geometries from left to right. (e) Average displacement of F atoms (uavg), serving as the order parameter for the ferroelectric−paraelectric transition, and the specific heat capacity across the phase transition. Here, uavg is obtained by computing the mean along the a-axis, taking its absolute value, averaging the result over the b-axis, and finally calculating the sample average across all samples. (f) Net magnetic moments as a function of the external electric field for P ↑ and P ↓ states. The solid lines denote the linear fitting.

Band structures with spin−orbital coupling of monolayer Cr₄S₄FBr₂ for the (a) positive (P ↑) and (d) negative (P ↓) ferroelectric polarization states. The Berry curvatures from first to the highest occupied (93rd) band near the Fermi level for the (b) P ↑ and (e) P ↓ states. The spin textures of the No. 93 for the (c) P ↑ and (f) P ↓ states, respectively.

(a) Side views of multiferroic tunneling junction (MFTJ) CSFB/CrSBr/CSFB with parallel (PC) and antiparallel (APC) magnetization configurations. The MFTJ comprises three regions labeled by blue and red arrows: the left and right terminals and a central barrier layer. Transport and current directions are aligned horizontally. (b) Bias-dependent current (I/nA) and magnetoresistance (MR) for PC and APC. (c) Spin-resolved transmission spectra of PC (top) and APC (bottom) of the MFTJ at the bias voltage of 0.04 V.
